name: North Coast X Black Label Fresh Press Rosin | Artic Gummiez (Tier 2)
description: After initial extraction, the rosin undergoes a cool, slow curing process at 60 degrees Fahrenheit. The terpenes separate and rise to the top during the curing process creating a top layer of flavors. Then the terpenes are whipped back into the rosin giving rise to a concentrate that is bursting with flavors.
